posts.title: The Small Internet
posts.description: A loose term with a fuzzy core The "Small Internet" is not a well defined term. Neither is it well distinguished from similar terms like " Smolnet ", " Small web ", " Web0 " 1 and others. It seems almost every person using the term "Small Internet" means something slightly different. Where all these different meanings overlap, they form a fuzzy common core, though.
